This looks like scrambled egg whites, with no yolk visible. The plate is about 20-25 cm across, and the pile covers roughly half of it. I estimate a mass of about 150 g. Egg whites run about 52 kcal per 100 g, which gives roughly 78 kcal. If some butter or oil was used in cooking, the total could be a little higher, so I'll say about 85 kcal.
